title: Mastercard Agent Pay — Agentic Token Scope & Consent-Policy Builder
description: Builds and lints a Mastercard Agent Pay Agentic Token scope — the agent-ID binding, merchant scope, and consent policy (spend limit, allowed merchants, expiry, velocity) that constrain a tokenised card credential issued to an AI agent. Field names are illustrative (MDES Agentic Token) — verify against Mastercard.
